MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Judge Ollie Marie-Victorie, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Karen Farnsworth, CSR #5162.
Bryan M. Grundon, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Lyon Financial Services, Inc., a Minnesota corporation dba US Bancorp Business Equipment Finance Group.
Dave Metzinger, custodian of books and records for plaintiff, was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant Globle Viva Inc., a California Corporation, dba San Francisco Computer Center, and Anna Yu.
Defaults entered against defendants on December 21, 2007.
Doe defendants dismissed on December 21, 2007.

After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff Lyon Financial Services, Inc., a Minnesota corporation dba US Bancorp Business Equipment Finance Group, and against the Defaulted Defendants Globle Viva Inc., a California Corporation, dba San Francisco Computer Center, and Anna Yu as follows:

Damages/Principal - $86,853.01.
Prejudgment Interest - $6,530.72.
Attorney's Fees - $2,825.00
Costs $505.00, for a total of $96,713.73.

Counsel for plaintiff shall prepare a proposed judgment and submit to the Court for review no later than 11:00 a.m. on Wednesday, March 12, 2008.
